cards.t: Strategy Buys 485 Bitcoin and Repurchases STRC Shares
cards.b: Strategy purchased 485 Bitcoin for $33.4 million and spent $228.1 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, funded primarily through common stock sales.

per.BTC: Strategy added 485 BTC to its treasury, bringing total holdings to 850,849 BTC.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: Solana Removes 'Beta' Label and Adopts Protocol Version 1.0
cards.b: The Solana Foundation officially retired the 'mainnet beta' label after six years, introducing Solana 1.0 as a shared protocol version.

per.SOL: Solana transitioned to version 1.0, establishing a shared version number for tracking network rules.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
